author: Aad, G. and others
title: Test of the universality of tau and mu lepton couplings in W-boson decays with the ATLAS detector
abstract: Using 139 fb-1 of proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s)=13 TeV, we report a measurement of the ratio R(tau/mu) = B(W->tau nu_tau)/B(W->mu nu_mu) from di-leptonic ttbar events. The measured value is R(tau/mu) = 0.992 +/- 0.013 [+/-0.007 (stat) +/- 0.011 (syst)], in agreement with lepton-flavour universality.
